title: Add a unit test for dupes.norm vendor matching
goal: dupes.norm has a small test proving that vendor names differing only in case, spaces and punctuation normalise to the same string.

files_to_touch.why: norm() is the function under test; do not change it

steps: Read norm() in app/dupes.py (about 3 lines) and do not edit it.
Create tests/test_dupes_norm.py that imports norm from app.dupes using plain asserts, no pytest.
Assert norm('Harbor Test-Bakery.') == norm('HARBOR TEST BAKERY') and norm(None) == ''.
Assert two different vendors (e.g. 'Harbor Bakery' and 'Harbor Bank') do NOT match.
Print OK as the last line when every assert passes.

notes: Do not touch the database, .env, db.env, data/ or the running service.

acceptance.expected_result: Running the test with the app venv exits 0 and prints OK; no other file changes.
